explanation_result.explanation:
+5.1% day-over-day move (z-score 2.65) on 2023-06-08. Reasons given by 2 reports from that day:
- "Coffee Prices Settle Sharply Higher as an El Nino Weather Pattern Develops" (theglobeandmail.com, 2023-06-08). Reported move: up 5.1%. Reason: Fund buying fueled a surge in coffee prices Thursday as an El Nino weather event has begun. Quote: "Fund buying fueled a surge in coffee prices Thursday as an El Nino weather event has begun" (source: 96d067b2ce34d373)
- "Café avança mais de 5 % na bolsa de Nova York" (globorural.globo.com, 2023-06-08). Reported move: up 5.1%. Reason: restricted robusta supply and speculative market moves. Quote: "o mercado encontra suporte na oferta restrita de café robusta, mas a alta hoje também foi impulsionada por movimentos especulativos." (source: 69a262b21b097279)
